agent.name: Organizational Adoption Agent
agent.specialty: Organizational readiness to absorb govern and sustain a specified application

analytical_question: For the hypothetical financial-services chart-agent proposal, distinguish readiness to plan, execute isolated public/synthetic learning, and operate next-quarter routine service under the permission_only organizational evidence profile without importing capabilities from another packet.
general_et_finding: Agentic AI combines model-selected tool actions, observations, scoped permissions and a human stop path; it creates organizational duties beyond ordinary BI charting: competent source checking, error escalation, access control, audit lineage, change management, monitoring, fallback and continuous service coverage. Its technology maturity cannot be inferred from this organization’s permission, staff or budget. C1 and C3 frame adoption as separate technology, task and organizational questions; S1/S2 offer voluntary role and lifecycle guidance, not proof of implementation.
application_finding: For human-supervised chart review, an analyst would submit a public or synthetic chart and its source table; read-only agent tools would draft source-linked discrepancy notes, which a qualified human accepts or rejects before any publication. Correct denominators, label interpretation, context and uncertainty matter; exceptions and ambiguous graphics require abstention/escalation. Task/technology fit and reproducible technical performance remain UNVALIDATED and comparative net advantage versus manual and deterministic review UNKNOWN in all four packets. Neither an approval nor a training dry run establishes accuracy, reduced total review burden or safe routine use.
organization_specific_finding:
CASE permission_only | Eight-domain case-evidence profile; SUPPORTED always limited to explicitly stated scope, PARTIAL is qualified and UNKNOWN is not failure:
Leadership/sponsorship — PARTIAL: Evidence: Sponsor plus security/model-risk authority approve limited POC, but no accountable project charter, named operating owner or residual-risk acceptance is specified. Consequence: Approval may lack execution responsibility. Closure: Reporting leader documents charter, appointed accountable owner and decision chain.
Skills/training — PARTIAL: Evidence: Experienced BI analysts only; no agent-review training, deputy or ordinary-user competency evidence. Consequence: Unsupported notes may pass review. Closure: Analytics manager records source-error, abstention and escalation exercise results for ordinary reviewers and backup.
Workflow/process — PARTIAL: Evidence: Human sign-off policy exists but no tested correction handoff, full review time, exception queue or manual fallback. Consequence: Theoretical oversight may fail in practice. Closure: Reporting owner performs witnessed handoff/fallback dry run and timed review.
Infrastructure/data — PARTIAL: Evidence: Approved isolated public/synthetic read-only environment is stipulated, not production use; detailed lineage/log verification is not supplied. Consequence: Trace failure or rights drift could undermine accountability. Closure: Security provides route/control inventory, sample trace and isolation/access verification.
Resources/budget — UNKNOWN: Evidence: No protected POC hours/cap, staff allocation or recurring operating funds provided. Consequence: Approval cannot mobilize reviewers or support. Closure: Finance/service lead confirms POC staffing cap and separately next-quarter amount, period and contingency.
Governance/risk — PARTIAL: Evidence: Model-risk/security coapprove the bounded trial; incident authority, tested stop, restore and change process absent. Consequence: Cannot assure safe response despite permission. Closure: Risk owner signs stop/escalation/change matrix and witnesses manual restoration.
Culture/change — UNKNOWN: Evidence: No representative user consultation, workload acceptance or safe-error-reporting record. Consequence: Unmeasured burden may derail learning; resistance not proven. Closure: Analytics lead records ordinary-user consultations, feedback and dissent route.
Operating ownership — UNKNOWN: Evidence: No accepted owner/deputy, maintenance rota or posttrial monitoring duty supplied. Consequence: PoC may be unmanaged or orphaned. Closure: Reporting head appoints owner/deputy and documents monitoring/support/retirement responsibilities.
Scope conclusions: PLAN: READY_TO_PLAN with bounded fictional permission. ISOLATED POC: NOT_READY_FOR_EXECUTION despite approval: no confirmed accountable operating owner, protected trained review/backup, cap or exercised incident recovery. ROUTINE: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_FOR_SUSTAINED_USE; no operating approval, results or sustainability evidence.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: All four cases share UNVALIDATED task/technology fit and UNKNOWN net advantage; no comparative agent trial or measured efficacy is provided.
T1 H2 readiness assumptions and other case premises cannot establish this case’s organization; no cross-case borrowing.
Case approvals and rehearsals are fictional stipulated premises, not independent enterprise audit, real deployment or certification.
Human review required by policy does not by itself prove an appointed competent or protected reviewer.
S1/S2 are voluntary editions, not binding regulation or evidence of current company implementation.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence in fictional bounded authorization; low confidence in actual capacity and exercised controls because evidence is missing, not adverse. A permission statement alone cannot establish safe POC execution. Source/case checked 2026-11-04; voluntary S1 2023-01 and S2 2024-07.
value_opportunity_implication: Potentially fewer chart-claim checking hours with stronger traceability, but the net benefit is UNKNOWN until comparative representative testing includes false/missed corrections, human correction, maintenance and support time. Conventional manual plus deterministic checks remain the baseline. Organizational readiness does not prove utility or authorize an adoption posture change.
risk_governance_implication: Main consequences are wrong denominators, invented links, privacy/access breach, misleading reports and inappropriate executive reliance. Restrict to reversible source-linked drafts, independently human-authorized publication, least privilege, full logs, escalation, incident stops, reviewer coverage and manual recovery. The risk owner must set materiality/tolerances; do not mistake a dry run for technical validation or assert legal compliance.
recommendation_management_implication:
Binding gap is execution capacity and control ownership, not permission. P1 proposed reporting head: appoint sponsor-facing service owner, deputy and residual-risk decision maker; closure signed acceptance/charter before execution; blocks POC. P2 proposed analytics manager and finance owner: reserve competent ordinary reviewers, maintainer, backups, reviewer/support hours and finite POC cap; demonstrate source/error/escalation exercise; closure rota, competency records and cap approval; blocks POC. P3 proposed security/risk owner: verify sandbox lineage, isolation and logs, exercise stop, incident escalation and manual restore with realistic workflow; closure witnessed test and signed stop matrix; blocks POC. P4 proposed analyst representatives: record acceptance and safe dissent; separately request recurring budget and release evidence; blocks sustained use. Four-week period is approval validity, not proof execution readiness.
CONDITIONAL DESIGN, not an executed study: across four weeks use analyst-submitted public/synthetic charts and source tables, read-only agent-generated source-linked notes, a qualified reviewer deciding accept/reject, and human-only publication. This case is PLANNING ONLY until separate authorized owners document and satisfy all permissions, staffing, competent reviewer/backup, approved route, stop/recovery, cap and acceptance criteria; permission alone is not enough. No POC budget or protected-hour cap is supplied in this case: secure explicit capacity/approval first; no 24-hour cap is imported. Agree task breadth, materiality/error tolerance and success criteria BEFORE execution; use normal, ambiguous and adversarial/incorrect-denominator samples plus absent-reviewer and incident/restore drills. Capture reproducible source traces, missed/false corrections, abstentions, unsupported claims, total setup/review/correction/support labor, reviewer feedback, cover and restore outcomes; compare manual/deterministic best baseline, not just model output. Stop and revert to manual review for forbidden access, publication escape, missing lineage/oversight, cap exhaustion, absent qualified coverage or material unsupported claims. Review in week four or earlier on incidents or changes to staff/model/data terms. Separate feasibility, incremental value and sustainable governance exit decisions; zero errors on a small set cannot certify production.
change_monitoring_triggers: Four-week review of actual control, trace, accuracy, effort and acceptance records, if an authorized study occurs; otherwise review documented readiness progress only.
Immediate reassessment after incident, lost lineage, forbidden access, changed model/tool/data terms, lost sponsor/reviewer/deputy or cap exhaustion.

Before any routine proposal, reassess next-quarter owner/cover, recurring signed budget, performance/value versus best baseline and separately granted risk/operating approval; quarterly thereafter if released.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: EXPLICIT CONDITION: No affirmative assurance of routine use until representative task performance/net value, authorized production route and risk release, funded covered owner/deputy and continued monitoring are evidenced; do not run a real trial based on this analysis.

MoE organizational intake (put labelled subfields inside existing capabilities_constraints/additional_context, not extra output keys): case/run ID; requested plan/POC/routine scope and horizon; evidence-as-of date and each document/source owner; sponsor/charter/permission/residual-risk decision rights; named service owner/deputy/rota and protected ordinary-user reviewer competency; handoff, signoff, exceptions, full review effort and fallback; approved model/tool/data route, access, isolation, logs and lineage; POC cap/hours/approver versus separately signed recurring amount/period/coverage/contingency; representative consultation/feedback/dissent; incident-stop-change authority and tested restore; monitoring, support, retirement and reassessment triggers.

Handoff to Adoption Agent/human: PLAN: READY_TO_PLAN with bounded fictional permission. ISOLATED POC: NOT_READY_FOR_EXECUTION despite approval: no confirmed accountable operating owner, protected trained review/backup, cap or exercised incident recovery. ROUTINE: INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE_FOR_SUSTAINED_USE; no operating approval, results or sustainability evidence. Binding dependency: owner, protected competent labor and safe recovery beyond permission. Carry closure artifacts, remaining limitations and change triggers forward without overturning T1 baseline DEFER automatically.
